name: Push-Up
formCues: Set up a rigid plank: hands under shoulders, legs long, glutes lightly squeezed.
Brace your core as if someone will poke your stomach — ribs down, neck long.
Bend elbows about 45° from your torso and lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your palms to straighten arms without letting hips sag or pike.

name: Lat Pulldown
formCues: Sit tall, thighs locked under the pad, chest slightly up.
Grab the bar wider than shoulders with a firm overhand grip.
Pull elbows down toward your ribs until the bar reaches upper chest.
Pause briefly, then let the bar rise with control without shrugging.

name: Bench Dip
formCues: Place hands on the bench behind you, fingers forward, feet out.
Keep shoulders down and chest proud — do not shrug into your ears.
Bend elbows to lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press through palms to straighten arms without locking hard.

name: Farmer's Carry
formCues: Deadlift the weights to standing: tall spine, shoulders packed, core braced.
Grip handles hard and keep knuckles facing forward — no shrugging.
Walk with even, short steps; look ahead and keep hips level.
Breathe steadily; stop and set weights down if you start leaning or twisting.
Place weights down with control by hinging at the hips, not rounding your back.
